description: Land Title Settlement Department - Makuluwa, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 830013
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for various parcels in Galle District. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, owners, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
